description.fun: A giant mushroom monster whose spiky caps look oddly like Poké Balls, though it supposedly comes from the ancient past. A paranormal magazine called it a cross between a dinosaur and Amoonguss, and its huge size and apparently low intelligence make it a savage fighter. The idea may nod to a real theory that fungal infections helped wipe out the dinosaurs.
description.guide: A Grass and Dark-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Scarlet, said to be either an ancient relative of Amoonguss or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It is named after a fierce mushroom creature described in an old expedition journal.
description.tagline: Amoonguss crossed with a dinosaur, and not very bright
